statement: Let G be a minimal-order counterexample to (2) for p = 2. Then G has a simple component L in the following list, where the field parameter q has characteristic at least five: PSLn(q), PSUn(q) n ≥ 4, PSp2n(q) n ≥ 3, Ω2n+1(q) n ≥ 2, PΩ± 2n(q) n ≥ 4.
